ui_bugs.issue: MoneyInput expects `testId` prop but the parent passed `data-testid` → spr-price-input was NOT rendered on the DOM (mobile SPR flow initially had no price input testid). Fixed by tester: changed data-testid="spr-price-input" to testId="spr-price-input" and rebuilt static bundle. Verified working after fix.

action_items: OPTIONAL: main agent may audit other MoneyInput usages to ensure `testId` (not `data-testid`) is passed where automated tests rely on the input testid. Grep already-scanned SpecialPriceRequestForm is the only occurrence found and has been corrected.
critical_code_review_comments: MoneyInput signature (components/MoneyInput.jsx L9) forwards `testId` -> DecimalInput data-testid; parents must NOT use data-testid=... with this component. This is a subtle API-shape trap — consider accepting both `testId` and `data-testid` in MoneyInput to prevent regressions.
SpecialPriceRequestForm correctly reused across mobile (MobileMore) and desktop (Pusat Persetujuan → Persetujuan Harga modal) after customer+product selection; single-source-of-truth requirement met.
Guardrails INV-RFID-01 and INV-ATOMIC-01 baselines HIJAU with self-tests passing (0 pelanggaran; ratchet held at 54).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Sesi 6 gelombang 2026-09 fully green. If future work touches MoneyInput or SpecialPriceRequestForm, re-verify data-testid="spr-price-input" is emitted (currently via testId prop). Frontend is static build — run scripts/rebuild_frontend.sh after any frontend/src change and wait ~30s before UI tests. Mobile shell reads kn_force_mobile in useState initializer, so set localStorage BEFORE login then reload.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the initial spr-price-input miss: MoneyInput component consumes `testId` (camelCase) and forwards it to inner DecimalInput as data-testid. Parent passed `data-testid="spr-price-input"` which fell through to ...rest and was applied to the wrapping DIV of DecimalInput (or shadowed), so the actual <input> element carried no matching testid, breaking Playwright selectors on both mobile and (implicitly) desktop. Mitigation: rename prop to `testId` at the callsite; longer-term, make MoneyInput accept `data-testid` as an alias.
